nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Pings the app every 5 minutes. Adjust interval as needed.

nodes.name: Init – Set Target & State
nodes.notes: Stores the URL to ping and retry counter. Change targetUrl to match the app under test.

nodes.name: HTTP Ping – Attempt 1
nodes.notes: First ping attempt. Timeout set to 10 s. Continues to error output on failure so retry logic can kick in.

nodes.name: IF – Status == 200?
nodes.notes: Routes to 'OK' path if status is 200; any other status (or timeout) goes to the alert path.

nodes.name: Log – Site is UP
nodes.notes: Records a successful ping. In production, append to a Google Sheet or database for the daily summary.

nodes.name: Retry 1 – Ping Again
nodes.notes: First retry after failure. Waits implicitly due to sequential execution.

nodes.name: Retry 2 – Final Ping
nodes.notes: Second and final retry. If this also fails, an alert is fired.

nodes.name: IF – Recovered After Retry?
nodes.notes: If the retry succeeded (200), skip alerting. If still failing, send a Discord alert.

nodes.name: Format – Downtime Alert
nodes.notes: Builds a red Discord embed with the failing URL, status code, and timestamp.

nodes.name: Discord – Send Downtime Alert
nodes.notes: Fires the alert to Discord. Uses the same webhook credential as Task 2.

nodes.name: Daily Summary (Stub)
nodes.notes: Stub for a daily summary. In production, trigger this at 23:59 and read aggregated stats from a Google Sheet or database.
